mapper.update: MERGE INTO A1_MFG.CONTROL_ABNORMAL_DETAIL A USING ( SELECT #{location} LOCATION,#{lot_id} LOT_ID,#{PRODSPEC_ID} PRODSPEC_ID,#{ope_no} OPE_NO,#{type} TYPE,#{reason} MAINTAIN_REASON,#{empid} EMPID FROM DUAL )B ON (A.LOCATION=B.LOCATION AND A.LOT_ID=B.LOT_ID AND A.PRODSPEC_ID=B.PRODSPEC_ID AND A.OPE_NO=B.OPE_NO AND A.TYPE=B.TYPE) WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET A.MAINTAIN_REASON=B.MAINTAIN_REASON,A.MAINTAIN_EMAIL=#{UPDATE_USER},A.MAINTAIN_TIME=SYSDATE,A.EMPID=B.EMPID WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT (LOCATION,LOT_ID,PRODSPEC_ID,OPE_NO,UPDATE_TIME,MAINTAIN_REASON,EMPID,MAINTAIN_TIME,MAINTAIN_EMAIL,NENG_FLAG,TYPE) VALUES (#{location},#{lot_id},#{PRODSPEC_ID},#{ope_no},SYSDATE,#{reason},#{empid},SYSDATE,#{UPDATE_USER},#{nengFlag},#{type})
